692	def _spec_confirmation(raw: Any, kind: str, lineage: dict[str, Any], root: Path, label: str) -> dict[str, str]:
693	    """C19 R3 の確定取込み: 完成度 evaluator の PASS report を根拠に、system-spec-harness 由来の章だけを確定で登録する。
694	
695	    evaluated_digest は取込元 bytes の source_digest に pin する。取込後に章が変われば lineage gate が落ち、
696	    PASS が別の bytes へ流用されることはない。report は repo 内の通常ファイルで、評価した spec_dir が取込元の
697	    ディレクトリと一致し、verdict が PASS のものだけを受ける。
698	    """
699	    if kind not in SPEC_IMPORT_KINDS or lineage.get("origin_kind") != "system-spec-harness":
700	        raise WriterError("confirmation_requires_spec_import",
701	                          f"{label}: confirmation_evidence is only for specification/architecture imported from system-spec-harness")
702	    if not isinstance(raw, dict) or set(raw) != {"evaluator", "evidence_ref", "evaluated_digest"}:
703	        raise WriterError("invalid_confirmation_evidence", f"{label}: confirmation_evidence is {{evaluator, evidence_ref, evaluated_digest}}")
704	    if raw["evaluator"] != SPEC_EVALUATOR:
705	        raise WriterError("invalid_confirmation_evidence", f"{label}: evaluator must be {SPEC_EVALUATOR}")
706	    if raw["evaluated_digest"] != lineage.get("source_digest"):
707	        raise WriterError("invalid_confirmation_evidence", f"{label}: evaluated_digest must equal source_lineage.source_digest")
708	    ref = raw["evidence_ref"]
709	    if not isinstance(ref, str) or not ref or Path(ref).is_absolute() or ".." in Path(ref).parts:
710	        raise WriterError("invalid_confirmation_evidence", f"{label}: evidence_ref must be a repo-relative path")
711	    try:
712	        report = load_json(contained(root / ref, root, must_exist=True))
713	    except (ContractError, OSError, ValueError) as exc:
714	        raise WriterError("invalid_confirmation_evidence", f"{label}: evidence_ref {ref} is unreadable ({exc})") from exc
715	    if not isinstance(report, dict) or report.get("verdict") != "PASS":
716	        raise WriterError("confirmation_evidence_not_pass", f"{label}: {ref} verdict is not PASS")
717	    spec_dir = report.get("spec_dir")
718	    source_dir = (root / str(lineage["source_path"])).parent.resolve()
719	    evaluated = Path(spec_dir).expanduser() if isinstance(spec_dir, str) and spec_dir else None
720	    if evaluated is None or (evaluated if evaluated.is_absolute() else root / evaluated).resolve() != source_dir:
721	        raise WriterError("invalid_confirmation_evidence", f"{label}: {ref} evaluated {spec_dir!r}, not the import source directory")
722	    return {"evaluator": raw["evaluator"], "evidence_ref": ref, "evaluated_digest": raw["evaluated_digest"]}

727	def _plan_add(payload: dict[str, Any], nodes: list[dict[str, Any]], root: Path, ctx: dict[str, Any],
728	              composer: Composer, now: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
729	    entries = payload.get("artifacts")
730	    if not isinstance(entries, list) or not entries or not all(isinstance(item, dict) for item in entries):
731	        raise WriterError("invalid_input", "add input needs artifacts[] objects")
732	    keys = list(composer.contract["common_frontmatter"]["required"])
733	    mode = _tracker_mode(ctx)
734	    taken_ids = {node.get("graph_node_id") for node in nodes}
735	    taken_paths = {node.get("file_path") for node in nodes}
736	    plan = []
737	    for index, entry in enumerate(entries):
738	        label = f"artifacts[{index}]"
739	        kind = entry.get("artifact_kind")
740	        _check_keys(entry, ADD_KEYS, label)
741	        if kind == "feature" and "macro" not in entry:
742	            _reject_feature(kind)
743	        if kind not in KIND_PREFIX:
744	            raise WriterError("invalid_kind", f"{label}: artifact_kind must be one of {sorted(KIND_PREFIX)}")
745	        if kind != "feature" and "macro" in entry:
746	            raise WriterError("invalid_input", f"{label}: macro is the C14 contract of feature nodes only")
747	        if kind == "feature" and "classification" in entry:
748	            raise WriterError("invalid_input", f"{label}: features are declared by C14, not classified; drop classification")
749	        slug = entry.get("slug")
750	        if not isinstance(slug, str) or not SLUG.match(slug):
751	            raise WriterError("invalid_slug", f"{label}: slug must match {SLUG.pattern}")
752	        graph_node_id, file_path = f"{KIND_PREFIX[kind]}-{slug}", f"{VGS.ROOT_BY_KIND[kind]}/{slug}.md"
753	        if graph_node_id in taken_ids or file_path in taken_paths:
754	            raise WriterError("duplicate_node", f"{label}: {graph_node_id} or {file_path} already exists")
755	        target = contained(_content_root(ctx, root, kind) / f"{slug}.md", root, must_exist=False)
756	        if target.exists() or target.is_symlink():
757	            raise WriterError("artifact_path_exists", f"{label}: {file_path} exists outside the graph")
758	        sections = entry.get("sections") or {}
759	        subtype_sections = entry.get("subtype_sections") or {}
760	        api_contracts = entry.get("api_contracts") or []
761	        if not isinstance(sections, dict) or not isinstance(subtype_sections, dict) or not isinstance(api_contracts, list):
762	            raise WriterError("invalid_input", f"{label}: sections/subtype_sections are objects and api_contracts is a list")
763	        subtypes = _subtypes(kind, entry.get("artifact_subtypes", []), len(api_contracts))
764	        if kind != "architecture" and subtype_sections or set(subtype_sections) - set(subtypes):
765	            raise WriterError("invalid_input", f"{label}: subtype_sections must target selected architecture subtypes")
766	        if kind != "specification" and api_contracts:
767	            raise WriterError("invalid_input", f"{label}: api_contracts apply to specification only")
768	        operations = [item.get("operation") for item in api_contracts if isinstance(item, dict)]
769	        if len(set(operations)) != len(operations):
770	            raise WriterError("duplicate_section", f"{label}: api_contracts repeat an operation")
771	        if kind == "feature":
772	            macro = _macro(entry.get("macro"), label, partial=False)
773	            classified = _declared(kind, file_path, "declared by the C14 macro contract (run-dev-graph-decompose)")
774	        else:
775	            macro = {"purpose": None, "goal": None, "scope_in": [], "scope_out": [], "acceptance": [], "architecture_refs": []}
776	            classified = _classification(entry.get("classification"), kind, slug)
777	        for field in ("title", "project_id", "domain"):
778	            if not isinstance(entry.get(field), str) or not entry[field].strip():
779	                raise WriterError("missing_required_field", f"{label}.{field} must be a non-empty string")
780	            if SECRET.search(entry[field]):
781	                raise WriterError("secret_like_content", f"{label}.{field}")
782	        node = {
783	            "graph_node_id": graph_node_id, "artifact_kind": kind, "artifact_subtypes": subtypes,
784	            "title": entry.get("title"), "project_id": entry.get("project_id"), "domain": entry.get("domain"),
785	            "status": "draft", "owners": entry.get("owners", []), "tags": entry.get("tags", []),
786	            "priority": entry.get("priority"), "start_date": entry.get("start_date"),
787	            "target_date": entry.get("target_date"), "iteration": entry.get("iteration"),
788	            "created_at": now, "updated_at": now, "depends_on": entry.get("depends_on", []),
789	            "related_nodes": entry.get("related_nodes", []), "resource_scope": entry.get("resource_scope", []),
790	            **macro,
791	            "parent_feature": None, "feature_package_id": None, "phase_ref": None,
792	            "file_path": file_path, "template_id": kind, "template_version": composer.contract["template_version"],
793	            "confirmation_status": "draft", "evaluation_status": "pending",
794	            "confirmation_evidence": {"evaluator": None, "evidence_ref": None, "evaluated_digest": None},
795	            "source_lineage": entry.get("source_lineage") or {
796	                "origin_kind": "generated" if kind == "feature" else "manual",
797	                "source_plugin": "dev-graph" if kind == "feature" else None, "source_path": None,
798	                "source_version": None, "source_digest": None, "imported_at": None},
799	            "classification_confidence": classified["confidence"], "classification_reason": classified["reason"],
800	            "classification_candidates": classified["candidates"],
801	            "github_publication": {"mode": "local_only", "project_aliases": [], "labels": [], "milestone": None},
802	            "issue_linkage": None, "tracker_binding": _tracker(entry.get("tracker_binding"), mode), "beads_linkage": None,
803	            "github_project_linkages": [], "pull_request_linkages": [], "execution_contexts": [],
804	            "completion_evidence": {"policy": "manual", "status": "not_applicable", "source": None,
805	                                    "completed_at": None, "reconciled_at": None, "evidence_refs": []},
806	        }
807	        lineage = LINEAGE.lineage_findings([node], root)
808	        if lineage:
809	            # 取込元が消えた・変わった lineage を登録すると、C19 の resume gate が後から必ず落ちる node になる。
810	            raise WriterError("source_lineage_unverified",
811	                              f"{label}: source_lineage does not resolve to the current system-spec bytes", lineage)
812	        evidence = None
813	        if "confirmation_evidence" in entry:
814	            evidence = _spec_confirmation(entry["confirmation_evidence"], kind, node["source_lineage"], root, label)
815	        state = {"subtypes": subtypes, "api_count": len(api_contracts), "node": node}
816	        body = composer.compose(kind, state, sections, subtype_sections, api_contracts)
817	        fill = composer.readiness(kind, subtypes, body)
818	        missing = [item["item"] for item in fill]
819	        node["implementation_readiness"] = {"status": "incomplete" if missing else "complete",
820	                                            "missing_sections": missing, "checked_at": now}
821	        if evidence is not None:
822	            if missing:
823	                # schema allOf[7]: pass は readiness complete を要する。確定で取り込む章は全 section を埋めて渡す。
824	                raise WriterError("confirmed_import_requires_complete_readiness",
825	                                  f"{label}: fill {missing} before importing as confirmed")
826	            # 確定した仕様は書き終えた成果物なので done にする。active だと schedule が着手候補として推薦してしまう。
827	            node.update({"status": "done", "confirmation_status": "confirmed", "evaluation_status": "pass",
828	                         "confirmation_evidence": evidence})
829	        text = _frontmatter(node, keys) + "\n" + "".join(body)
830	        taken_ids.add(graph_node_id)
831	        taken_paths.add(file_path)
832	        detail = {"graph_node_id": graph_node_id, "file_path": file_path,
833	                  "classification": {key: classified[key] for key in ("decision", "confidence", "margin")},
834	                  "implementation_readiness": node["implementation_readiness"]["status"],
835	                  "missing_sections": missing, "readiness_fill": fill}
836	        plan.append({"node": node, "before_node": None, "path": target, "before": None, "text": text,
837	                     "label": label, "detail": detail, "declared": classified["decision"] == "c14_macro_contract"})
838	    kinds = {node.get("graph_node_id"): node.get("artifact_kind") for node in nodes}
839	    kinds.update({item["node"]["graph_node_id"]: item["node"]["artifact_kind"] for item in plan})
